operationalNotes: Eve emitted MaxListenersExceededWarning messages. Both sessions completed with exit 0 and no retained session/turn/step failure events.

After slot 2 printed its passing summary, Eve logged a queue HTTP 503 / socket hang up. Both stage receipts, exact skill materialization, source identity and exported artifacts were complete; retained as an operational warning, not a discarded or retried sample.

During slot 2, user requested workspace-only disk cleanup. Disposable previous control installs, pre-current-day Eve runtime snapshots and an inactive prior Next build were removed. Frozen run files and all current eval evidence were preserved; final integrity validation passed.
limitations: Two fresh sessions provide observations, not a reliable adoption rate or evidence of improvement.
Neither agent consumed the split skill, so this cohort did not exercise its SKILL.md → scene.md path.
Math is optional; correct handwritten interpolation is accepted. No conclusion that installation would improve correctness.
The task renders one rotating body with three markers, not a large hierarchical scene or ECS integration.
Stage-one sources already clamp outside the range according to static review. No carry-forward replay was run; no measured adaptation benefit claimed.
Software Mesa rendering verifies function, not hardware performance.
recommendedNextExperiment: Keep this spontaneous-discovery task unchanged. Add a separate task condition that explicitly asks the agent to follow the vgpu skill, without naming math or scene.md, to test the index-to-reference journey.
